text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I happened to spot Zenno Rob Roy and the 
others in the cafeteria kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
First, regarding the ingredients, in the 
story they use seven-colored glowing 
carrots found at the base of a rainbow.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~, a rainbow, huh! Hope one shows up 
at just the right time.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A rainbow might be manageable, but glowing 
carrots in seven colors don't exactly 
exist in reality...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be wiser to think of 
substitutes and combine them instead...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Like carrots of each color, maybe? Blue 
carrots and purple carrots? Mmm... this 
feels like another tough puzzle~.
choice_data_list: What on earth are you making?
What on earth are you making?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, we're trying to recreate the 
'Seven-Colored Carrot Cake' that appeared 
in a book I recently read...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's a story about three chefs traveling 
in a food truck, cooking in various lands—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The cake made with ingredients gathered at 
the end of their adventure looks so vivid 
and delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Since it's a fictional dish, recreating it 
is difficult, but I thought by challenging 
ourselves, we could touch the world of the 
story...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Adventure, exploration, El discovery! I'm 
back, deeeees!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Rob Roy! I gathered the 
ingredients for 'Pitch-Black Cream Mixed 
with Nightfall'!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
99% cacao chocolate, bamboo charcoal 
powder, and the finishing touch: squid ink 
paste!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
El-san...! Let's try making a prototype of 
the 'Pitch-Black Cream' right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began their trial-and-error cake 
making—

text_block_list.name: Rob Roy and the Others
text_block_list.text: It's doooone!!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Bueno! This pitch-black decoration is 
quite a faithful recreation, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely...! Now, as long as the 
cross-section shows beautiful, neat layers 
of seven colors—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¿¡Qué?! What is THIS?! The cross-section 
is a messy, chaotic marble pattern, des!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Something green is oozing out from 
between the sponge layers?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah... r-right, now that I think about it, 
I read in a cooking book that the purple 
pigment anthocyanin discolors easily...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I should have researched ways to prevent 
the colors from bleeding together...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry, everyone... My preliminary 
research wasn't thorough enough...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it, don't sweat it! It's 
normal for things not to work out on the 
first try! Let's give it another shot!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Así es! The strong learn from their 
failures—that's my papa's teaching!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, truly. If I were alone, I surely 
would have just sulked over the failure, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Joining forces with everyone to create 
something... We succeeded in recreating 
that special experience after all...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa...! This cake might look a bit 
weird, but it's super yummy!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¿¡Qué?! That's unfair, Tannhauser! El-El 
is gonna eat too!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, w-wait for me. Me too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three of them lively shared the cake. 
The time spent cooperating together seemed 
to make it taste all the more delicious.
